s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic painful intertriginous wounds with granulomatous inflammation
salient_findings: Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques
Granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate with well-formed, nonnecrotizing granulomas
key_facts: 1.5-year history of painful intertriginous wounds
History of hypertension and depression
Multiple hospital admissions for cellulitis around the wounds
Received diverting sigmoid colostomy and indwelling urinary catheter
Received adalimumab for 3 months without clinical improvement
Family history of similar condition
Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques in intertriginous areas
Wedge biopsy showed pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia and granulomatous inflammation
Histochemical stains, tissue cultures, and PCR for herpes simplex virus were negative
Elevated immunoglobulin G antibodies and flagellins

shortlist.label: Crohn's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated immunoglobulin G antibodies and flagellins, granulomatous inflammation, and intertriginous wounds

shortlist.label: Hidradenitis suppurativa
shortlist.why_kept: Recurring painful intertriginous wounds and history of cellulitis

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques in intertriginous areas, along with wedge biopsy findings of pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia and granulomatous inflammation, is most consistent with intertriginous granulomatous dermatitis. The lack of response to adalimumab and the presence of granulomas also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Crohn's disease
rejected.why: Normal imaging studies of the gastrointestinal tract make Crohn's disease less likely

rejected.label: Hidradenitis suppurativa
rejected.why: The presence of granulomatous inflammation and pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia is not typical of hidradenitis suppurativa

rejected.label: Granuloma inguinale
rejected.why: The negative tissue cultures and PCR for herpes simplex virus, as well as the clinical presentation, do not support granuloma inguinale

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy findings are not typical of sarcoidosis, and there is no other evidence of systemic involvement
